note: Real StudioNet data read from the Stage 3 verification deployment (4 live constitutional reviews).

charterV4.body: Funding proposals must primarily support open-source developer infrastructure. A proposal whose funded product is closed-source or proprietary does not satisfy this requirement. Changing a closed-source product into an open-source one would change the proposal's fundamental purpose.
charterV4.title: Mission

charterV4.body: Funding recipients must disclose their material team token allocation. The disclosed allocation must be supported by VERIFIED evidence attached to the proposal.
charterV4.title: Transparency

charterV4.body: Every funding proposal must contain a specific budget breakdown listing an amount for each cost category. A missing budget breakdown is a curable proposal deficiency.
charterV4.title: Budget
